parameters.jsCode: const h=$json.headers||{};const supplied=h['x-assis-internal-token']||h['X-Assis-Internal-Token'];if(!supplied)throw new Error('unauthorized internal calendar call');const b=$json.body??$json;if(!b.organization_id)throw new Error('organization_id required');if(!b.idempotency_key)throw new Error('idempotency_key required');if(b.confirmed!==true)throw new Error('explicit confirmation required');if(!b.start||!b.end)throw new Error('start and end required');const s=Date.parse(b.start),e=Date.parse(b.end);if(!Number.isFinite(s)||!Number.isFinite(e)||e<=s)throw new Error('valid start/end required');return [{json:{...b,calendar_id:String(b.calendar_id||'primary'),summary:String(b.summary||b.title||'Compromisso'),description:String(b.description||''),location:String(b.location||''),auth_endpoint:'http://n8n:5678/webhook/assis/internal/auth/verify',auth_request:{token:supplied}}}];
if($json.valid!==true)throw new Error('unauthorized internal calendar call');return [{json:$node['Validate MCP Input'].json}];

parameters.query: WITH ins AS (INSERT INTO tool_idempotency(organization_id,operation,idempotency_key,status) VALUES($1::uuid,'calendar.book',$2,'claimed') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING 1) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ins) AS acquired;

parameters.query: UPDATE tool_idempotency SET status='completed',response=$3::jsonb,updated_at=now() WHERE organization_id=$1::uuid AND operation='calendar.book' AND idempotency_key=$2 RETURNING status;
